Container.Name: StockWorks
Container.Overview: StockWorks is a FastAPI-powered inventory and quoting tool for 3D-printing studios.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Container port exposed by the FastAPI server

Config.Name: Appdata Storage
Config.Description: Host path that stores the SQLite database and attachments

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns files written inside the container

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns files written inside the container

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask applied before StockWorks starts

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for logs

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Optional PostgreSQL DSN shared with MakerWorks/OrderWorks (leave blank for SQLite). If the URL contains ?schema=orderworks, StockWorks keeps its own tables out of the OrderWorks schema unless STOCKWORKS_DB_SCHEMA is set.

Config.Name: StockWorks DB Schema
Config.Description: Optional explicit PostgreSQL schema for StockWorks-owned tables. Leave blank to preserve existing public-schema installs.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Location inside the container that holds the SQLite file

Config.Name: Database Filename
Config.Description: SQLite filename stored under STOCKWORKS_DATA_DIR

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Credential required to log into the StockWorks UI

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Credential required to log into the StockWorks UI (12+ characters)

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Secret used to sign session cookies (32+ characters)

Config.Name: HTTPS-Only Session Cookie
Config.Description: Set to 1 when the app is accessed via HTTPS so login cookies are marked Secure

Config.Name: OrderWorks Base URL
Config.Description: Optional OrderWorks dashboard URL used for Open links

Config.Name: PrintLab Base URL
Config.Description: Optional PrintLab URL used to read loaded AMS trays. Use the PrintLab container name when all Works containers share makerworks-net.

Config.Name: PrintLab API Key
Config.Description: Optional API key for PrintLab API access

Config.Name: PrintLab Bearer Token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token for PrintLab API access

Config.Name: PrintLab Username
Config.Description: Optional PrintLab username for Basic auth when PrintLab REQUIRE_AUTH is enabled

Config.Name: PrintLab Password
Config.Description: Optional PrintLab password for Basic auth when PrintLab REQUIRE_AUTH is enabled

Config.Name: PrintLab API Auth Header
Config.Description: Header name PrintLab expects for PRINTLAB_API_KEY

Config.Name: PrintLab Trace Logging
Config.Description: Set to 1 to enable PrintLab integration trace logs
